lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Tara! Mohan! Please, call my children. Tell them their mother has come back.
lines.sfx_cue: police station gate clangs, crowd murmuring

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Stop there. Do not cross the desk until I ask you.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then ask quickly. I have waited... I have waited long enough.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Your name.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Meera. Devraj's daughter. Tara and Mohan's mother.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: She says she is the dead woman.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Call her father. Let him see her face.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: He will know me. Bring him here. Please.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Constable, shut the gate. Nobody leaves, and nobody touches her.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Move aside. I will settle this.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Baba...

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Do not call me that.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Look at me. Properly. The cut above my eyebrow, I got it on your grain scale. You carried me home.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Many people have scars.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Your left knee hurts before you sit. You hide money inside the red account book. Baba, please... just hold my hand.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Do not touch me.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: One touch. You will know.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I buried my daughter. I placed wood on her pyre with these hands. You are an impostor.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Her own father will not touch her.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Someone trained her. Why else would she come here?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I came for my children. Where are Tara and Mohan?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: My grandchildren have already suffered. They will not be displayed before a stranger.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: They are not your shield. Bring them.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Sub-inspector, remove this woman before Tara hears this filth in the market.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No. She entered a police station and made an identity claim. We record it before anyone removes anyone.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The police recorded her death. Is your own record now a rumour?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: One fact at a time. Meera, when did you last see your children?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The morning I disappeared. Tara would not drink her milk. Mohan had fever... no, the fever began the night before.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: All of that was discussed after the funeral. Anyone in Dharmapur could repeat it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Not this. Mohan called fever medicine bitter rain. Tara drew a moustache on the bottle so he would laugh.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Enough.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You know that happened.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I know grief makes foolish people generous with information.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Babulal, bring the death entry and the original identification file.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Madam, that file is sealed with the murder case.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then open the cupboard, not the seal.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: If the woman is genuine, every connected page will have to be reviewed.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: If. Please remember that word.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Show me what you wrote about me.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: There is a death certificate, cremation acknowledgement, family identification and a station register entry.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And my children were made to live under those pages.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Give me the date and status.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Fourteenth November, two thousand twenty-two. Meera, daughter of Devraj, recorded deceased.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I am standing in front of you.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The station register still lists Meera as dead.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: And four men are in jail for murdering her.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: If that woman goes near Tara or Mohan, I will hold this station responsible for what it does to them.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Your concern is noted. Now step away from the door.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Do not send him away. Let him hear every answer.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No. Private details are useful only when the crowd cannot feed them to you.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: She already knows enough to perform.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You will wait outside until I call you.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: This is my daughter's case.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: That is precisely why you do not conduct the test.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Very well. Test her. But do not mistake confidence for truth.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Close it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: How long before I see my children?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: When I can put you near them without turning two children into evidence.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: They are already evidence. Everyone outside is saying their mother's name.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Sit. One fact at a time.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I cannot sit quietly while Baba calls me an impostor.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then sit angrily.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You think I am lying.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: I think the register says you are dead, you say you are alive, and four prisoners cannot both have murdered you and not murdered you.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Ask me something.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: What did Devraj break on the day Tara was born?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Nothing. He claimed the tea glass broke by itself. Actually, he squeezed it when the nurse said the baby was a girl.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Where did the glass cut him?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Between his thumb and first finger. He hid the bandage before entering my room.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: What did he bring you?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Two oranges and the wrong slippers. Both were for the right foot.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: What colour?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Green, with silver flowers. I wore them anyway because he looked so ashamed.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Mohan's first word.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Not Ma. Everyone says Ma. It was wheel. He pointed at Baba's bicycle and said it until he slept.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: What frightens Tara?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: People knowing she is frightened. She will stand near any snake if someone is watching. Alone, she cannot even touch a shed snakeskin.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: That answer may matter later.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: It matters now. Bring her.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You keep saying not yet. I heard that for months. Food, not yet. Outside, not yet. Home... not yet.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Who said that to you?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I will give a full statement. First let my children see my face.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Your conditions do not control this inquiry.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And my father's fear should not control it either.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then why is he still the one deciding who I am?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: He is not.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Devraj. Come in alone.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Has she failed?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: She answered six questions. Four match your earlier family statement exactly. Two were never in the file.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then someone in the family spoke carelessly.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Say my name once while looking at me.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I will not reward manipulation.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Did you break a tea glass when Tara was born?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I may have. That was many years ago.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Did you bring two right-foot slippers?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Small family stories travel. Evidence does not.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You said you brought evidence.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The hospital photographed the burned body before identification. I identified the tattoo and the black thread tied at the wrist.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: My mother tied that thread after Mohan's fever. I never removed it.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The body had the same thread. The same tattoo. That is why I signed.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Describe your tattoo without looking at the photograph.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Three dots above a small crooked leaf. The woman made the last line too deep. It is here, on my left hand.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: A tattoo can be copied after the case becomes public.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: After? Look closely. The leaf has stretched with my skin. This is not new.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Babulal, bring the identification record.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Madam, the hospital note says black thread at wrist and tattoo visible beside it.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Does it specify left or right?

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: No. Only the photograph shows the side.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I saw the mark. I had just lost my daughter. Do not examine my grief as though it were a crime.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: I am examining the identification.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Which hand?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The image may have been reversed during printing.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The hospital number is readable, not reversed.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Which hand, madam? Please... say it.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The photograph shows the tattoo on the body is on the opposite hand from Meera's tattoo.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Open the gate. My children are inside that house.
lines.sfx_cue: police jeep brakes, iron house gate rattles

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You enter under police guard, and you do not force either child to approach you.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I am not forcing them. I am coming home.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: This has not been her home since the cremation.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You burned another woman's body and gave away my room. Neither act changes whose house this is.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The body identification is under review. Do not state conclusions before the evidence does.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then let the evidence open the gate.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I will open it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Tara.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Do not call me like that.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Like you have been searching every room and finally found me.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: That is exactly how I am calling you.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Sub-inspector, you said she was only coming to look at the house.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: She is here to identify private details. You may stay, or you may leave the room.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I am staying.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Where is Mohan?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: He does not want to see you.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: That is not what I said!

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Mohan? Open the door, little wheel.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: He locked himself in the storeroom when the jeep came.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: He is frightened.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: He is confused. There is a difference.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: This is why I refused. The boy has already mourned once.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Because you told him I was ashes.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Because I identified his mother's body.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Enough. Tara, show us the rooms without giving her clues.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Fine. If she is my mother, she should not need clues.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I do not.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Then start here. What was kept in that wall niche?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The brass lamp. Except during exams, when you hid your school timetable behind it.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Anybody could have seen the lamp.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Nobody saw the sums you wrote on the wall behind the timetable. Seven times eight was fifty-four until I made you correct it.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I was small.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You cried because the wrong answer looked neater.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Tara, you do not have to listen.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I said I am staying.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Next room.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: What was under the bed?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: A steel trunk, one broken sandal and Mohan whenever he stole jaggery.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: I did not steal it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: No. The jaggery climbed into your pocket by itself.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Open the door. I will not come close. I only want to see how tall you are.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: If I open it, will the police take you away?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I don't... I cannot promise what the police will do. But I will not leave without telling you.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No one is taking her away today unless evidence requires it.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: That is not a promise.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No. It is the truth.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Mohan, remember the tune I used when your chest hurt?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Do not sing it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Because he wants you to be her. He will believe anything if you use her voice.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: My voice did not die because you were told I did.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: You know stories. You know rooms. You even look like the photographs. But I will not call you mother.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Not today?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Not until I decide.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You have heard her. This visit should end.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: No. My room is left.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: That room is used for storage now.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then your storage is sleeping in my room.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Open it.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: There is nothing relevant inside.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You do not decide relevance.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The blue wall is gone.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: It was painted after the funeral.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: My mirror was on that nail. The cot faced east. I kept Tara's first school ribbon inside the mirror frame.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: The mirror broke years ago.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then the ribbon may still be behind the loose brick below the nail.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Tara, were you aware of that hiding place?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: There are dozens of loose bricks in an old house.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Third brick from the corner. It has a white scratch shaped like a hook.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Do not help her. I will check.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: There is something inside.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: A faded school ribbon, blue and white.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You cried on your first morning, Tara. So I cut my own blue scarf and tied a matching ribbon around my wrist.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: A hidden object proves you knew this house. It does not prove why you left it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I did not leave you willingly.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: There. Now comes the accusation that protects her from every question.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: She has not given the allegation yet.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I will. But not while he turns every word into shame.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Then answer me without him. Why did you not come back?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Because I could not. Because every time I thought I had a road home, someone closed it. I tried to remember your faces exactly, but Mohan kept growing in my head and you... you stayed thirteen.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I was fourteen when you disappeared.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: No. Your birthday was eleven days later. I had hidden your present in the grain drum.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: What present?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Red glass bangles. You said you were too old for dolls and too young for gold. I never got to give them to you.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Tara, enough. Pain is not proof.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Is she crying?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Stay inside, Mohan.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: I want to see her.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Then why did you lock the door?

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Because if she is not Ma, I will lose her again.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You do not have to open it today. I will sit outside.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You will not occupy this courtyard until the village accepts you.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The village does not issue identity certificates.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The village will still remember who brought scandal to its doors.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: And it will remember who refused evidence when it was placed in his hand.

lines.speaker: VOICE AT GATE
lines.text: Police! I have come from the Kota bus stand. I need the officer handling the returned woman's case.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: BUS STAND VENDOR
lines.text: I run the tea counter beside the departure bays. Her face was in today's paper.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Where did you get that?

lines.speaker: BUS STAND VENDOR
lines.text: It was behind an old timetable at my counter. I remember the day because these two waited there for three hours.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Which two?

lines.speaker: BUS STAND VENDOR
lines.text: This photograph shows Meera standing beside Raghav.
